correctness.rationale: The exact twelve signed-permutation sites give 24 adjacent pairs, 8 triangular cliques and no 4-clique. For t<π/4 all nonadjacent pair distances are ≥π/2, so inclusion–exclusion terminates at triples. Spherical Gauss–Bonnet computes the stated two-cap lens and three-cap curvilinear triangle. A direct Voronoi-cell inequality gives sharp radius π/4. Tangent-plane scaling at the 8 triangular face normals gives 3√3ε² triple onset; square-hole normal coordinates at the six axial farthest points give 6ε²/π+2ε³/π+O(ε⁴). The embedded checked code corroborates integer incidence, independent quadrature, 262144 quasi-Monte-Carlo directions and high-precision coefficients; finite checks are not used as proofs.

value.rationale: The configuration of twelve cuboctahedral points is the contact shell of face-centred-cubic sphere packing and a canonical nonoptimal twelve-cap spherical covering. The theorem supplies its complete uniform nearest-vertex distance law, exhibits the geometrically forced first-pair and first-triple overlap transitions, and quantifies a sharp two-term tail for the six worst-covered directions. These are useful fixed-configuration coverage/quantization invariants not given by the classical packing radius alone; the value is in the complete natural distribution and structural phase behavior, not a routine parameter substitution.
